owner_instruction.statement: I want to update our defense to this more meta 6-1 defense, espeically since we started getting cooked in the playoffs a bit. This defense is a bit more risky and startegic but I want to try it out. I believe this is out of the Vikings playbook but if this formation shares a playbook with any of our old formations let me know and we can run a scheme with both formations
owner_instruction.source_material: Owner 13.5 MB '6-1 Defense' PDF of Civil.gg 61 Defense scheme screenshots (https://www.civil.gg/members/schemes/madden/61-defense-v3?sid=95; file not committed). Eight pages, 14 call cards, all in 4-3 Even 6-1. The PDF does not name an NFL playbook on the cards.
owner_instruction.effect: Every league (Lions, CPU, Chiefs, Titans, Giants) uses a new Patriots-context defensive scheme: the 14 transcribed 4-3 Even 6-1 PDF calls, plus the 11 current Nickel 2-4 Wide civil calls that exist in the Patriots book, plus the 7 existing Nickel Single Mug stock setups that also exist there. Dime 2-3 Odd / DB Fire 2 is dropped (not in the Patriots book; no stock book has 6-1 + Nickel 2-4 Wide + Dime 2-3 Odd + Nickel Single Mug). Patriots is preferred over Vikings because it has the most overlap with our old formations while still containing all four PDF 6-1 plays (including Tampa 2). The Ravens two-formation dataset and the NSM dataset file stay in the repo for rollback. 6-1 macros and user assignments are UNVERIFIED. Offense books, cooldowns, catalog version, and the shared additions SHA are unchanged.

playbook_choice_reason: Aidan believed the 6-1 was out of the Vikings playbook. The in-repo snapshot confirms Minnesota Vikings has 4-3 Even 6-1 with all four PDF plays (Cover 4 Quarters, Sam Will Blitz, Tampa 2, Cover 3 Buzz) and also has Nickel 2-4 Wide (all 11 current civil nickel base plays). New England Patriots has the same 6-1 four-play set and the same Nickel 2-4 Wide plays, and additionally has Nickel Single Mug with all 7 existing NSM setups. No stock book contains 6-1 plus all three old formations. Chargers also has Nickel 2-4 Wide + NSM but lacks Tampa 2 in 6-1, so the red-zone and Gun 5 WR Tight Tampa 2 calls would be illegal there. Patriots is the playbook with the most legal overlap. Owner t463u kept the Patriots book but dropped Nickel Single Mug from the live call pool; the NSM file stays in the repo for rollback.
label: Patriots 4-3 Even 6-1 + Nickel 2-4 Wide civil defense
dropped_reason: Dime 2-3 Odd (and DB Fire 2) is not in the Patriots book. The only 6-1 book that also has Dime 2-3 Odd is the Raiders, which lacks Nickel 2-4 Wide and Nickel Single Mug. Owner t463u: do not call Nickel Single Mug. The NSM dataset file remains in the repo unused.

gaps_and_caveats: The PDF does not name an NFL playbook; Vikings was Aidan's belief. Videos are shot in a Buccaneers stadium (Civil.gg branding), which is not treated as a playbook claim.
No stock book has 4-3 Even 6-1 together with Nickel 2-4 Wide, Dime 2-3 Odd, and Nickel Single Mug. Dime 2-3 Odd / DB Fire 2 cannot be included in the Patriots scheme.
6-1 macros (61 Base, 61 Murple, Cover 2 Match, C2 Man Match, HB Dive Run D, HB Zone Stretch D) and all user assignments are unverified in Xbox.
Owner asked for some situations to get their own macros later (red-zone D; Gun 5 WR Tight Defense 3; Advanced Blitz; Gun Tight). Those cards currently use 61 Base or Cover 2 Match as shown.
Gun Tight Defense 1 is inferred: the p08_top screenshot has no situation tab bar in frame.
The PDF has no Prevent, no dime pass-rush, and no separate goal-line formation. Inside the 10, the PDF's Tampa 2 call plus the remaining midfield 6-1/nickel calls stay available.
The Civil.gg scheme is not situation-gated to the named offensive formations in the live caller (those tags are on the card); only the Inside The 10 Tampa 2 call is field-gated.
Owner t463u: do not call Nickel Single Mug. The seven NSM setups are not in the live pool; the NSM dataset file remains in the repo unused.
